author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 겨울철새 수천 마리 · 나그네새 수백 마리

months.note: 11월~2월에 가장 많이 보이며, 번식지에서는 5~6월에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 봄과 가을에 한국을 지나가는 나그네새이자 이곳에서 겨울을 나는 겨울철새로, 잔디밭과 구릉, 관목림에서 지낸다. 주로 식물 씨앗과 열매를 먹고, 여름철에는 곤충을 먹는다. 한배에 알 4~6개를 낳는다. 전국에서 볼 수 있으며 국외에서는 캄차카, 오호츠크해, 사할린, 쿠릴 열도, 만주, 중국, 일본에 분포한다.

points.en: bold black streaks on the flanks

sexes.male: 겨울깃 수컷은 뒷목의 밤색 띠가 비교적 또렷하고, 머리꼭대기·얼굴·멱 아래·윗가슴의 검은 무늬가 담황색 깃 끝 사이로 비친다.
sexes.female: 암컷은 머리와 가슴의 검은색이 적고 갈색을 띠며, 뒷목의 밤색 띠가 흐릿해 겨울깃 수컷보다 칙칙하다.

young: 어린새(유조)는 온몸이 담황색을 띠고 등·머리·가슴에 검은 세로줄이 빽빽하며 뒷목의 밤색 띠가 없다. 첫겨울 수컷은 가슴 깃의 검은 무늬가 크고 뒷목이 밤색을 띠어 어른 수컷에 가깝고, 첫겨울 암컷은 얼굴과 가슴의 검은색이 더 적다.

art.subject: Lapland Longspur (Calcarius lapponicus), adult male in breeding plumage, as seen in Korea just before it leaves in late March and April: crown, face, chin, throat and upper breast solid black; a buff-white stripe running from behind the eye down the side of the neck to the breast side, framing the black face; nape and hindneck bright chestnut; mantle and back brown streaked black and buff; greater coverts edged rufous, forming a chestnut panel between two thin white wing-bars; rest of the underparts white with bold black streaks on the flanks; tail dark brown with white outer feathers. Bill short and conical, yellow with a dark tip; iris dark brown; legs dark brown.
art.pose: standing upright on a low tussock in side view, head raised, showing the black face, chestnut nape and black bib
art.scene: Korean early spring in late March: short-grass field and dry farmland on low hills near the west coast, pale fresh green just appearing; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male winter, side view walking on the ground: streaked brown crown, buff face with dark-bordered ear coverts, partly veiled chestnut nape, mottled black upper-breast patch, rufous panel between two white wing-bars, buffy-white underparts with bold black flank streaks, brown back streaked black

adult male breeding (worn only from late spring, rarely seen in Korea), side view standing: solid black crown, face, chin, throat and upper breast, buff-white stripe from behind the eye down the neck side, bright chestnut nape, yellow bill
adult female winter, side view on the ground: like the winter male but without the black breast patch, only fine dark streaks on the breast, duller chestnut nape and rufous wing panel
art.build: Stocky, ground-dwelling bunting-like bird, 15cm, slightly larger than a sparrow, with a flattish crown and short neck. Bill short and conical, shorter than the head. Legs short and dark; the hind claw is very long and straight. Walks and shuffles on the ground rather than hopping, often crouched low in short grass. Wings long, with the primaries projecting well beyond the tertials at rest. Tail fairly short, notched, dark with white outer feathers. Flies in flocks with an undulating flight.
avoid: Do not mix the plumages: the breeding male has a clean solid black face and bib; the winter male only a mottled black breast patch and a buff face.
Do not show it hopping; it walks and shuffles on the ground.
Do not give it large white wing patches like Snow Bunting, or any yellow on the throat.
Do not omit the rufous wing panel and the chestnut nape.
